notes: The Inventory switch you could not see. On each ore line of a refining order there is a switch that adds the refined ore to your Inventory once you collect it - it was just a small box icon whose only explanation was a hover tooltip, which does nothing on a phone. It now says "Stock" underneath. Marking an order collected also tells you what it is about to do: whether the ore is being added to your Inventory or not. Before, if the switch was off, nothing was added and nothing said so, which made it look like the feature was missing. Forgot to flip it? Open the order, turn Stock on and save - the ore is added then and there, even on an order you have already collected or sold, and a lot you had already corrected by hand will not be overwritten with the estimate. The switch still starts off on purpose: if you only track quality ore you should not be made to carry every order. Reported by MantisOlthoi.
